changes.description: Retired into Map and a Table. The practitioner, 2026-11-20: "I also noticed comparison map widget is still in the palette. We should have retired it already." The geoprivacy example's comparison is now a Map of the original and moved points, both mean centres and the pumps as point layers, and a Table of the distances Compare point sets measures. Its representative donuts are given up; its caveat, that the view keeps original coordinates and is for teaching, not sharing, is in the example's notes. A saved workflow whose Comparison map is fed by Compare point sets opens rewritten that way. Retired outright, with no deprecation period, because nobody outside this project uses it (AGENTS.md). docs/audits/comparison-map-retired.md.

evidence.note: Projection, count, display and SHACL checks; no privacy guarantee or independent scientific certification.
